title: Your Nav and Cards Still Break

blocks.content: Course: Make Your Code Work on Every Screen
Your Nav and Cards Still Break
By this point, your layout structure is responsive. The hero switches from one column to two. Sections stack properly. Your breakpoints work.
But when you resize the browser to 320px, something still feels wrong.
The layout technically works, but it doesn't feel comfortable.
That's because we fixed the page structure in Chapter 2. Now we need to fix the components inside that structure.

items: Replace a rigid grid with flexible cards
Fix the navigation direction for mobile
Understand exactly where the new CSS goes
